narrative.overview: A dark mineral world drawn from the approved faceted illustrations. Portraits are substantial content, not avatars. Broad color fields and a measured sans-serif pairing let a person and their way of thinking lead the experience. The physical use scene is a quiet, low-light viewing session with time to read a personal story; the dark ground preserves the portraits’ own charcoal environment.
keyCharacteristics: Large portrait illustration and restrained copper emphasis.
Flat square controls with clear, human labels.

rules.name: The Material Rule
rules.body: Keep the image’s copper, carbon and mineral tones connected to the surrounding field; do not recolor a portrait into an unrelated theme.

dos: Do keep body copy readable against the field it inhabits.
Do identify stylized portrait imagery as illustration.
Do preserve native controls and no-script reading access.
donts: Don't turn the portrait geometry into a decorative component costume.
Don't imply contact delivery or invent commercial evidence.
